title: IdentitySignInFailedPayload
description: Payload of `identity.sign_in.failed` version 1: a failed attempt to sign in or to prove the signed-in person, for detecting credential stuffing. The answer to the caller is the same whatever the reason; this event carries the true one. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Never carries an email address, a phone number, a password or a code. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

identifier_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalised identifier (email address, phone number or service credential), in lower-case hex: the same identifier always gives the same digest, so repeated attempts can be told apart without naming it.

audience.description: The surface the attempt was for; `service` for a service credential. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.

reason.description: Why it failed: no account for the identifier, an account without a password, a wrong password, a wrong one-time code, a wrong second step, a disabled account, a surface the account may not enter, an attempt refused by the throttle, a wrong current password when changing it, a wrong password or authenticator code when stepping up, or an unknown service credential. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.

source.description: The client address the attempt came from, read behind the trusted proxies.
